Class ZipFormat

java.lang.Object
com.saicone.nbt.util.zip.ZipFormat
Direct Known Subclasses:
ZipFormat.Gzip, ZipFormat.Lz4, ZipFormat.Zlib
public abstract class ZipFormat extends Object
Utility class for compression algorithms related methods.
Compatibility with gzip, zlib and lz4 is provided by default.
